entries.heading: Section 916 of Public Law 112-95 is amended by striking
ancestors: DIVISION K—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 119E.  Section 916 of Public Law 112-95 is amended by striking 
``Advanced Materials in Transport Aircraft'' and inserting ``Joint 
Advanced Materials and Structures''.
